explanation: The Dixmier Conjecture as in Adjamagbo-van den Essen arXiv:math/0608009 (every endomorphism of A_n(K) in char 0 is an automorphism; Theorem 7 chain). Bijective AlgHoms are exactly automorphisms, and WeylAlgebra has the relations [x_i,y_i]=1. The negation follows from JC_3's failure: the map F in Wikipedia/JacobianConjecture.lean has Jacobian -2 and is non-injective (reported by Tao, Cook and AFP sources; I could not read the X post itself) together with DC_n⇒JC_n. Holds for any fixed char-0 K, since F is defined over ℚ. Correct.
